theorems.name: Submission.coarea_gluing_of_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n m k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (w : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞) (S : ℕ → Set (Rn N)), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContinuousOn f U → (∀ Z ⊆ M, μHE[n] Z = 0 → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn m)), μHE[k] (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) = 0) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j)) → μHE[n] (M \ ⋃ j, S j) = 0 → (∀ j, ∀ B ⊆ S j, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in B ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ x in B, φ x * w x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in B ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume) → ∀ A ⊆ M, NullMeasurableSet A μHE[n] → ∀ g : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, AEMeasurable g ((μHE[n] : Measure (Rn N)).restrict A) → ∫⁻ x in A, g x * w x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in A ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, g x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume
